events.text: Let me run the preflight probe first.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Run the screenshot preflight probe
events.input: $ timeout 90 python3 app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py preflight 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "exit=$?"; which python3

events.name: Bash
events.head: Find how accessibility is checked and which binary needs it
events.input: $ grep -n -i "accessib\|AXIsProcess\|realpath\|executable" app/scripts/shots/claude-app-shots.py | head -15; python3 -c "import sys,os;print(os.path.realpath(sys.executable))"; ps -o comm= -p $PPID
